relevant.instructions: Is this job posting genuinely about software development, engineering, or a closely related technical role — as opposed to sales, marketing, management, or unrelated fields?

seniority.instructions: What seniority level does this role require?

criteria.mid: 2-5 years experience, no seniority qualifier in title

remote.instructions: Does this posting explicitly offer remote or hybrid-remote work?

recruiter_spam.instructions: Is this a vague staffing-agency post with no real company or project details, as opposed to a genuine listing from a specific company?
